title: Those who wait upon the LORD will renew their strength
note: 9 slides; slide 7 redrawn once for garbled film-border lettering
caption:
Which one did you need today? Tell us its number.

For the days when you feel worn thin, here is a reminder that your strength does not have to come from you. Lean on Him a little more today.

Isaiah 40:31, Romans 5:8, Nehemiah 8:10, Matthew 11:28, Psalm 121:2, Psalm 46:1, 2 Corinthians 12:9, Ephesians 6:10 (BSB)

Share it with someone who is carrying a lot.

slides.text: Those who wait upon the LORD will renew their strength
Your worth was settled at the cross.
The joy of the LORD is your strength.
You were never meant to carry it alone.
My help comes from the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in times of trouble.
My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is perfected in weakness.
Be strong in the Lord and in His mighty power.
Save this for the day you need it
